name: Codex
description: OpenAI Codex CLI: chat with Codex inside {appName}. Sign in with your ChatGPT account (the CLI needs a paid plan such as Plus) or use an OpenAI API key (billed per use).

signIn.label: Sign in with ChatGPT…
signIn.tip: Opens the ChatGPT sign-in page in your browser. The app never sees your password.
signIn.intro: Signing in with your ChatGPT account. Your browser opens; finish there.

signIn.label: Sign in with ChatGPT (device code)…
signIn.tip: Shows a code to type on a ChatGPT page, for when the browser can't open here. Device-code sign-in must be switched on in your ChatGPT security settings first.
signIn.intro: Follow the steps shown here to sign in with a device code.

signIn.label: Codex's own sign-in screen (has the API key choice)…
signIn.tip: Starts Codex, which asks how to sign in. To use an OpenAI API key, pick its API key choice and paste the key into Codex's own prompt; the app never handles the key.
signIn.intro: Codex asks how you want to sign in. Choose with the keys shown.

signOut.confirm: Sign Codex out on this computer? (It signs out the codex command everywhere, not only here.)

panelNote: You are running inside the built-in AI panel of {appName}. The user answers your questions with buttons made from your text. Whenever you offer the user choices, put them at the very end of your message as a numbered list, one per line (1. ..., 2. ..., 3. ...), and always finish the list with one more numbered option: Something else - type what you want.
